title: Kissing Sound (Mwah)
blurb: MWAH — affection at maximum theatricality, and entirely without contact. This single syllable spans an impressive range: the chef's kiss of appreciation, the greeting somebody continental, and the deeply unsettling menace-flirting that occurs in Discord calls at one in the morning. Its versatility is precisely the point. Use it to celebrate something perfect, to say hello in a way nobody asked for, or to make an entire voice channel go quiet. One button, infinite social chaos, zero actual kissing required at any stage.
